text: Testing plays an important role in software development. Unit tests check small parts of the code, such as a single function, to make sure they work correctly. Integration tests go further by checking how different parts of the system work together. Many developers use test-driven development, which means they write tests before writing the actual code. This approach helps them find problems early and design better software. The main benefit of testing is confidence. When tests pass, developers feel safe making changes, because they know the tests will catch mistakes. In short, regular testing saves time and produces more reliable software.
